field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF, all four XML tables, all ten figures, and every current final activity/toxicity record were reviewed. Table 2 has 26 numeric inhibition-circle observations and 10 dash exclusions mirrored correctly, but nine accepted xml:p:39/Figure 5 stability records are entity-mislinked: the source describes CFS/cell-free supernatant stability, while final records label the assayed entity and peptide as Bacteriocin P7.

Five DBAASP fallback machine candidate rows were reviewed and remain unresolved/non-authoritative. No source_verified database identity is claimed, authoritative linked row counts are zero, candidate sequence fields are null or literal None, and no plain one-letter sequence plus sequence_length object exists for residue-count validation in the current final records.

All six current JSON files in papers/PMC11897483/final and packets/PMC11897483/final are byte-identical, and live rework requests/responses/closure receipts compute zero open tickets. However packet_manifest.json still reports open_rework_ticket_count=1 with an empty open_rework_ticket_ids list, conflicting with live ticket state, analysis_status.json, final materials_manifest.json, and the current strict acceptance report.

Mechanism claims preserve ontology boundaries: no claim remains direct_mechanism, direct_assay_types are empty, SDS/permeability language is retained as inferred discussion context, and antimicrobial phenotype evidence is separated from molecular mechanism closure.

Paper identity is traceable to title, DOI 10.3389/fphar.2025.1530043, PMID 40078294, and PMC11897483. Entity linkage fails for the p39/Figure 5 accepted activity records because CFS/cell-free supernatant stability observations are attributed to purified Bacteriocin P7.

Most locators and unit normalization checks passed: Table 2 values retain mm, MIC retains μg/mL, hemolysis retains %, and final mirrors match. The p39/Figure 5 rows have valid value locators but invalid entity normalization to Bacteriocin P7, and packet_manifest ticket count provenance is stale relative to live rework state.

Recursive authority and release boundaries are preserved: fallback DBAASP machine rows remain candidate-only, source_verified count is zero, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, and the strict acceptance artifact states that authoritative DBAASP ingest still requires linked authority rows and release approval.

Preserved cautions are scientifically real: no authoritative DBAASP linked rows, Figure 3/Figure 4 activity surfaces remain unresolved rather than row-level exact values, and p49 versus p57 hemolysis thresholds are both represented as cautionary threshold evidence. These do not repair the p39 CFS-to-P7 entity error.

The staged supplementary directory is readable and empty; the XML contains no supplementary-material links; packet supplementary_index lists no files; supplementary_text is empty; supplementary_tables has no tables; and archive_manifest lists no archives. No supplementary source surface remains uninspected.

Toxicity/selectivity evidence is represented: Figure 10A exact hemolysis values 0.8193%, 3.7988%, and 10.949% are present for MIC, 2MIC, and 4MIC; p49 <10% MIC-2MIC and p57 <5% MIC-2MIC threshold prose are preserved with caution status; source methods identify domestic chicken erythrocytes/chicken blood.

blocking_findings.reason: Nine accepted p39/Figure 5 activity_records are not source-reviewable because their entity and peptide fields say Bacteriocin P7, while the primary source locator is the stability-results surface for CFS/cell-free supernatant. Source p39 discusses CFS antimicrobial activity under pH and UV treatments; Figure 5 is captioned as cell-free supernatant stability. Purified Bacteriocin P7 activity is reported later at xml:p:45/xml:p:47/xml:p:49. The current strict acceptance artifact reports zero hard findings, so it accepted around a material entity-scope error.
required_actions: Re-open xml:p:39, xml:fig:5, and the PDF Figure 5 surface and rebuild the nine accepted stability records with entity/peptide/sample scope as CFS, cell-free supernatant, fermentation broth, or another exact source-supported term, not purified Bacteriocin P7.
Preserve the existing p39 values, targets, units, exact-vs-approximate status, and pH/UV conditions only where the source binds them.
Keep the separate purified Bacteriocin P7 records at xml:p:45, xml:p:47, xml:p:49, and xml:fig:10 distinct from CFS/stability records.
Update paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json mirrors byte-identically and rerun strict source-level checks.
acceptance_checks: A script over both final activity_toxicity_evidence.json mirrors finds zero accepted records with source_locator/source_locators containing xml:p:39 or xml:fig:5 and entity or peptide equal to Bacteriocin P7.

The same script finds the nine p39/Figure 5 source values 15.96 ± 0.66, 12.24 ± 0.24, 12.12 ± 0.38, 13.96 ± 0.06, 11.92 ± 0.33, 10.05 ± 0.28, 23.78 ± 0.29, 22.56 ± 0.59, and 14.14 ± 0.39 retained only under a source-supported CFS/cell-free-supernatant entity scope.

The regenerated strict acceptance audit no longer reports publication_grade_ready around this p39 entity-scope check.

cautions.summary: No authoritative DBAASP/merged sequence, literature, article, or assay rows are linked; five DBAASP machine rows remain unresolved/candidate-only and must stay excluded from RC2, portal, or authoritative ingest.

Figure 3, Figure 4, and Figure 10B/C are represented as unresolved or excluded activity-bearing surfaces because exact row-level visual values were not safely recoverable from the local packet; this is acceptable only as a preserved caution, not as quantitative evidence.
The source reports both p49 <10% at MIC-2MIC and p57 <5% at MIC-2MIC; final toxicity preserves exact Figure 10A values separately from threshold prose, so the discrepancy remains a caution.
